run.notes: PAIRED A/B, CPU ARM, ABBA. Context sweep at concurrency 1, 4 contexts x 2 output lengths, 3 repeats per pass, TWO passes per arm in ABBA order (CPU, GPU, GPU, CPU) so a linear thermal drift cancels between arms. Each pass started only after a >=120 s cooldown with the CPU package <=50 C and the GPU <=45 C. Figures are the mean of the two passes' per-cell medians; raw min/max span all 6 repeats. BOTH ARMS SERVE THE v2 EXACT Q4_0 GGUF (xbill9/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-exact-gguf, SHA-256 419db9a6, 2,620,370,912 B), the first paired run on it; every earlier paired run served Google's gemma-4-E2B_q4_0-it.gguf. Both arms: llama.cpp f95b0d9 (the same binaries as 2026-09-22, by sha256), identical flags except -ngl, -t 6 -tb 12 from both tpu.env files. Thinking ON for every request (the server default then; sweep.py now asks for it explicitly). Prompt cache verified defeated: 0 of 28,553 prompt tokens cached in every pass. Host: Lenovo Yoga 9 15IMH5, i7-10750H 6C/12T, GTX 1650 Ti Max-Q, one shared thermal envelope; package throttle events rose 50,918 in CPU pass 1, 3,209 in GPU pass 1, 4,932 in GPU pass 2 and 59,190 in CPU pass 2 - several times 2026-09-22's (9,604 / 420 / 2,879 / 19,279), with the package at 90 C at the end of both CPU passes. Page cache hot throughout. Arm attested from /proc on both passes: device=cpu, exe=/home/xbill/llama.cpp/build-cpu/bin/llama-server, sha256=9c88c7821fcc11a6, model /home/xbill/models/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-exact-v2/gemma-4-E2B-it-q4_0-exact.gguf. Not comparable to 2026-09-22 as a file comparison: the weights changed and the host ran much hotter; see the run's REPORT.md.

host.notes: 6 cores / 12 threads, homogeneous Comet Lake - NO P/E split; SMT siblings pair (0,6)...(5,11). avx2, NO avx_vnni, NO AVX-512. 15 GiB RAM. Lenovo Yoga 9 15IMH5, bare metal. No CPU affinity was set for this run; what that costs is unresolved - the prior llama-bench sweep that put it at 1.61x via E-core stragglers described a hybrid die this machine does not have, and is quarantined. CORRECTED 2026-09-22 (was: 12 cores / 16 threads, hybrid 4P+8E, avx_vnni).

model.architecture_notes: Reasoning model: tokens arrive as reasoning_content until the thinking block closes; sweep.py counts both. v2 exact rebuild: every weight matrix is Q4_0 (both embeddings and per_layer_model_proj included), only 1.1 MB of F32 norms otherwise. per_layer_token_embd (1.32 GB, 50% of the file) is TENSOR_READ_LAZY.

workload.notes: decode-source auto -> stream; llama-server emits no usage.decode_tokens_per_second, so decode is client-side inter-token latency off the SSE stream. Prompts are device-neutral and identical across arms. prompt_mode=unique (per-request nonce first, so the prefix cache cannot hit). 6 = 3 repeats x 2 ABBA passes.

memory.notes: NOT re-measured on the v2 file. The RssAnon figure previously here (1,202,152 kB, 2026-09-16) was on Google's file. weights_gib is the v2 file's resident part (everything except the lazy per_layer_token_embd).
